relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: minted - camelCase verb phrase; captures a distinct evaluation-frequency fact (once per query block vs. once per produced object) that neither seeAlso nor any existing predicate expresses
relations.evidence: The WITH clause is evaluated once per query block, and LET is evaluated for every object produced by the FROM or JOIN clause.

cross_component_finding: Confirms the credential-type/privilege pair generalizes cleanly to a SELECT-context clause (WITH/CTEs) with the exact same object concepts already minted for comma.json's plain FROM/SELECT read path (privilege:capella-basic-access-read, privilege:capella-advanced-access-query-read) - no new privilege names needed here, reinforcing that 'Read'/'Query Read' is the stable read-side pair alongside the write-side 'Write'/'Query Index' pair seen on DDL pages.
